prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Unity, Spitter. The one reference defines creature identity/silhouette and view. Redraw continuous actions of this same creature. Matte dark brown rock armor, pale gray-white tendon limbs, restrained amber eye slit, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45-degree game camera, upper-left soft light. Four-legged acid spitting alien with brown rocky hood/head armor, pale gray sinewy FOUR limbs, one very large pale yellow-green veined throat/belly bladder hanging under chest, smaller brown dorsal plates. Preserve the reference's bulbous ventral green sac silhouette; the sac is at FRONT underside, not an orange/purple back organ. Single head, no extra sacs.
Direction ALL frames: FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing bottom-right. No angle changes during skill or death.
Strict layout FOUR columns x 6 rows = 24 separate full drawings. Tall PORTRAIT canvas, width-to-height ratio 4:6. IMPORTANT: not landscape. Empty transparent margin takes 20 percent on every side of EVERY cell, including space between rows. Full silhouettes including legs must NEVER touch adjacent poses. All drawings same scale, central placement and foot baseline. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real four-leg alternating gait, heavy green throat bladder follows subtly, stable body. Row3: FOUR IDLE breath poses with gentle sac motion. Row4: FOUR SPIT WINDUP frames: feet brace, front head lifts slightly, green throat bladder gradually inflates and tenses, mouth opens at final frame. Row5: FOUR SPIT/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame mouth opens and throat bladder squeezes, then head recoils, bladder relaxes and mouth closes. Do NOT paint the projectile or a detached liquid stream (Unity owns it). Row6: FOUR non-explosive DEATH frames: legs buckle, hood/head rests on floor, green bladder slackens and dims without rupturing, eye goes dark.
Real articulated movement, no exact duplicate or transformed still frames. Four legs, single head, consistent anatomy and armor. True alpha0 transparent empty canvas including gaps inside limbs; no floor, shadow, opaque backdrop, text, labels, grid, particles or projectiles.
